summary: Focused E2E test of new Plant Hazard Checks (PHC, QMSF 31) module — backend + frontend. All 5 backend bullets and all 9 frontend bullets PASS. Backend pytest: 12/12 tests passing (auth gating, 16 hazard categories A-P, stats shape, full CRUD with auto-incrementing phc_no, search filter, overdue_for_review increments correctly for past next_review_date). Frontend Playwright: login as admin/admin123, navigated to /safety/plant-hazard-checks, page renders with QMSF 31 badge + 2 stat cards. New Assessment form shows 16 hazard rows A-P. Risk auto-compute verified: applies=Yes + Consequence=3 + Likelihood=D produced 'Medium' badge (3*(6-4)=6 → Medium). Save returned to register showing PHC-04 TEST_Pedestal Grinder QA. Search 'Pedestal' filtered to the record. Edit → changed reason to 'Edited Reason E2E', save, page reload, value persisted. Print opened new tab with title 'PHC 4 — TEST_Pedestal Grinder QA', containing both 'PLANT HAZARD CHECK / RISK ASSESSMENT' heading and QMSF 31 doc-control footer. Delete confirmed, row disappeared, Total stat decremented 1→0. Test record cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend create_phc returns 200 — acceptable but REST convention prefers 201 for POST creates. Non-blocking.
list_phc uses sort('phc_no', -1) with no pagination (length=1000). Fine for ISO compliance register scale; consider pagination if records grow beyond 1000.
stats overdue query uses string comparison on ISO dates ($lt today). This works because ISO-8601 lexicographic order == chronological — verified by overdue test.

Pre-existing (NOT introduced by PHC): Mixed Content console errors on /api/settings/ (http vs https). Not caused by this module — same issue noted in iteration_13. Recommend E1 patch /api/settings/ caller to use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
Minor: PHC delete uses window.confirm (native dialog). Works fine in Playwright via dialog handler. Consider migrating to AlertDialog for consistent UX, but not blocking.
test_credentials: admin / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Login form uses placeholders 'Enter username' / 'Enter password'; inputs lack name attributes — use placeholder selectors. Submit button label is 'Sign In'.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates and cleans up TEST_Pedestal Grinder QA + TEST_OverdueMachine records (both DELETE 200, GET 404 verified). Frontend test record (PHC-04) was deleted at end of run — total stat returned to 0. No residual test data in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PHC module backend at /api/plant-hazard-checks (router prefix in plant_hazard_checks_routes.py:11). Frontend at /safety/plant-hazard-checks. Key data-testids: phc-page, phc-new, phc-form-page, phc-machine, phc-applies-A..P, phc-save, phc-print, phc-edit-<id>, phc-search, phc-stat-total, phc-stat-overdue. Risk formula in PlantHazardChecks.js:33 computeRisk(c,l): score=c*(6-likIdx); >=16 Extreme, >=10 High, >=5 Medium, else Low. phc_no auto-increments via ncr_counters collection (shared counter doc id='phc_no'). After this iteration the counter is at 4 (PHC-01..PHC-04 used). Print uses window.open + setTimeout w.print() — Playwright captures the popup via expect_page; do not assert browser print dialog itself.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. All review-request bullets PASS.
